verdict.rationale: YubiKey is a hardware authentication device that stores keys and secrets on its secure element. It does not ingest or process user content in a way that could feed AI model training, so an AI-training opt-out is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Yubico offering any AI-training-related data control that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
